title: 환율 고시
description: finance 데이터베이스의 exchange_rate 테이블을 통화별로 조회한다. 모든 쿼리는 date 인덱스를 타도록 날짜 범위 조건을 함께 건다.

list.name: tz
list.label: 고시 시각 시간대
list.description: exchange_rate.date + time 이 어느 시간대의 벽시계 시각인지. 이 값으로 UTC 타임스탬프를 만든다.

panels.title: $currency 매매기준율
panels.description: 선택 구간의 마지막 고시값. CNY·RUB·TWD는 최근 exchange_standard_rate 가 0으로 들어오므로 (buy + sell) / 2 로 대체한다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(quoted_at, $__interval),
  avg(rate) AS "매매기준율"
FROM (
  SELECT
    (date + time) AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS quoted_at,
    CASE WHEN exchange_standard_rate > 0 THEN exchange_standard_rate ELSE (buy + sell) / 2 END AS rate
  FROM exchange_rate
  WHERE currency IN (${currency:sqlstring})
    AND date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
                AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
) AS quotes
WHERE $__timeFilter(quoted_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $currency 매매기준율·살 때·팔 때
panels.description: $__interval 단위 평균. 통화마다 자릿수가 달라 패널을 통화별로 반복한다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(quoted_at, $__interval),
  avg(rate) AS "매매기준율",
  avg(buy) AS "살 때",
  avg(sell) AS "팔 때"
FROM (
  SELECT
    (date + time) AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS quoted_at,
    CASE WHEN exchange_standard_rate > 0 THEN exchange_standard_rate ELSE (buy + sell) / 2 END AS rate,
    buy,
    sell
  FROM exchange_rate
  WHERE currency IN (${currency:sqlstring})
    AND date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
                AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
) AS quotes
WHERE $__timeFilter(quoted_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 선택 구간 변화율 비교
panels.description: 구간 첫 값 대비 변화율. 자릿수가 다른 통화를 한 축에서 비교하려고 정규화한다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH quotes AS (
  SELECT
    (date + time) AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS quoted_at,
    currency,
    CASE WHEN exchange_standard_rate > 0 THEN exchange_standard_rate ELSE (buy + sell) / 2 END AS rate
  FROM exchange_rate
  WHERE currency IN (${currency:sqlstring})
    AND date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
                AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
), sampled AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(quoted_at, $__interval) AS bucket,
    currency,
    avg(rate) AS rate
  FROM quotes
  WHERE $__timeFilter(quoted_at)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  bucket AS "time",
  currency AS metric,
  (rate / first_value(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY bucket) - 1) * 100 AS value
FROM sampled
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 최신 고시
panels.description: 통화별 마지막 고시 한 줄. 대시보드 시간 범위와 무관하게 최근 3일에서 찾는다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (currency)
  currency AS "통화",
  (date + time) AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS "고시 시각",
  round AS "회차",
  CASE WHEN exchange_standard_rate > 0 THEN exchange_standard_rate ELSE (buy + sell) / 2 END AS "매매기준율",
  buy AS "살 때",
  sell AS "팔 때",
  send AS "보낼 때",
  receive AS "받을 때"
FROM exchange_rate
WHERE currency IN (${currency:sqlstring})
  AND date >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date - 3)
ORDER BY currency, date DESC, time DESC
